source.species_table_ends_before: Island_name Euref_X Euref_Y Potential_spp Num_colonizing Prop_colonizing Random_effect

semantics.Potential_islands: number of the 471 study islands from which the species was absent in the historical inventory and therefore potentially able to colonize

integration_rule.priority: if a validator-clean v1.168 lookup is committed, use it as the historical source-count authority in v1.164 rather than attempting inversion of model-scale Historical_total_log
integration_rule.join_key: exact species string after Unicode NFC + trim; no fuzzy matching
integration_rule.missing_archive_species: archive species lacking exact supplementary join are topology-ineligible
integration_rule.extra_supplement_species: permitted only if not present in routed archive; they do not create archive rows
integration_rule.exact_source_identity: for each archive species, routed historical-absence row count must equal Potential_islands; if equal and historical_source_count>=1, complement is exact
